structure types.name: ipv6 header

fields.name: payload length
constraints: length of the ipv6 payload, i.e., the rest of the packet following this ipv6 header, in octets.

fields.name: next header
constraints: identifies the type of header immediately following the ipv6 header.
length of payload length must be consistent with the total packet size.

structure types.name: hop by hop options header

fields.name: hdr ext len
constraints: length of the hop-by-hop options header in 8-octet units, not including the first 8 octets.

fields.name: options
constraints: variable-length field, of length such that the complete hop-by-hop options header is an integer multiple of 8 octets long.
must immediately follow the ipv6 header. presence is indicated by next header == 0.

structure types.name: routing header

fields.name: hdr ext len
constraints: length of the routing header in 8-octet units, not including the first 8 octets.

fields.name: type specific data
constraints: variable-length field, of format determined by the routing type, and of length such that the complete routing header is an integer multiple of 8 octets long.
must be identified by next header = 43.

structure types.name: fragment header

fields.name: reserved
constraints: initialized to zero for transmission; ignored on reception.

fields.name: fragment offset
constraints: the offset, in 8-octet units, of the data following this header, relative to the start of the fragmentable part of the original packet.

fields.name: reserved flags
constraints: initialized to zero for transmission; ignored on reception.
must be identified by next header = 44.

structure types.name: destination options header

fields.name: hdr ext len
constraints: length of the destination options header in 8-octet units, not including the first 8 octets.

fields.name: options
constraints: variable-length field, of length such that the complete destination options header is an integer multiple of 8 octets long.
must be identified by next header = 60.

parsing context.name: fragment identification
parsing context.type: source address, destination address, and fragment identification (for reassembly)

helper functions.name: calculate pseudo header length
helper functions.description: used for calculating the upper-layer packet length in the pseudo-header (e.g., tcp/udp). if the upper-layer protocol provides its own length field, use that; otherwise, use the ipv6 payload length minus the length of any extension headers present between the ipv6 header and the upper-layer header.

transform functions.name: reassemble fragment packet
transform functions.description: performs reassembly using matching source address, destination address, and fragment identification. computes the reassembled payload length using the formula: pl.orig = pl.first - fl.first - 8 + (8 * fo.last) + fl.last. the fragment header is removed.
